Subject: Request: tailored IR walkthrough + artifact list before SOC 2 scope review

Hi Marissa,

Hope you’re well. We’re kicking off our planning for Redwood’s upcoming SOC 2 scope review (scheduled for late November) and the auditors have asked for a short, targeted incident response (IR) walkthrough plus an artifacts list they can use to pre-map evidence to the trust services criteria.

Specifically they want:
- A 30–45 minute walkthrough of your IR process (roles, escalation, evidence retention).
- A short index of artifacts we can ingest ahead of the call (IRP, postmortems for any customer-impacting incidents in the last 12 months, runbooks, logging/retention policies, ticket exports).
- A redlineable CAIQ/SIG crosswalk if you have one (mapping controls we claim to the standard).

Can you send a single-zip evidence pack or a shared folder link and propose 2 times for the walkthrough next week? Our audit team members: Devon Price (me) and Aisha Ramesh — we’ll share the auditor names once times are confirmed.

Thanks — we try to keep these prep calls brisk and focused.

Best,
Devon
Security Audit Manager
FinSecure

Attachment: requested_fields_template.csv (CSV stub)

- Tue 11/10 09:00–09:45
- Wed 11/11 14:00–14:45

1) Incident Response Plan (IRP_v2.1.pdf) — procedures, roles, comms templates, escalation matrix.
2) IR evidence index (IR-evidence-index.csv) — one-line artifact descriptions, control mapping, and retention windows.
3) Recent postmortems (redacted) for customer-impacting events in past 12 months (sanitized).
4) Logging & telemetry exports guidance (S3 access logs, request-id correlation, retention policy statement).
5) PagerDuty playbook export + ticket-id examples (forensic ticket IDs only).
6) CAIQ mapping draft (msp-soc2-mapping.docx) — shows where we map our controls to CAIQ/SIG items.

Karthik — can you pull the IR evidence index and the sanitized postmortem set by EOD Monday? Laura — would you join the walkthrough for control mapping questions? Ben — FYI for procurement/audit negotiation context.

We’ll share a Drive link with view+comment access; anything that’s sensitive will be delivered via the secure evidence bucket (S3 presigned URL).

If those times don’t work, propose alternatives and we’ll adjust.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Security Solutions 
Redwood Inference
